notes: Simpler interface. The filter and stop-management checkboxes have been removed and are now configured automatically, so there is nothing to tick before starting the bot. IMPORTANT: two filters that were blocking entries (Trend HTF and H4 Hard Block) are now off by default, so the bot will take noticeably more trades than before. Break-even, trailing stop and stop-loss cooldown remain active automatically. Risk % per trade and the automation and alert options are unchanged. Test on a demo account first to confirm the new activity level suits you.
